_doc: LOCKS (Phase 030): keys and locks. A key is a discrete item (a ToolItem of kind KEY_KIND, weighing KEY_WEIGHT) carried like a tool, so it can be given, dropped, picked up and taken. It opens every lock whose lock_id it carries. A lock is a container's lock_id and locked flags, or the town store's (STORE_LOCK). A lock with keys_required above 1 opens only once that many distinct keyholders have each unlocked it at the lock's cell; one person cannot supply two. STORE_LOCK is the founding state of the town store: unlocked, so the default town is unchanged. Its lock_id is an identifier, not a figure: it differs from the container lock ids the scenarios use, so one key does not open both. KEY_WEIGHT is APPROX: a design choice; no source was consulted (a door key is a few tens of grams).
